newsitem.title: UK: DMG bank appoints MD for funds' FX cover.
newsitem.headline: DMG bank appoints MD for funds' FX cover.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Wednesday it had appointed Wayne Grigull as managing director of its Institutional Client Group, heading global foreign exchange for hedge funds.
Grigull joins DMG, the investment-banking arm of Germany's Deutsche Bank, from Merrill Lynch and Co Inc where he headed U.S. and Asian foreign exchange sales. He will be based in New York, DMG said.
"This appointment completes the integration of DMG's foreign exchange sales business," said DMG.

DMG's foreign exchange sales business comprises the Corporate Group headed by Zar Amrolia, the Investor Group headed by Elaine Lloyd and the regional Asia Pacific headed by Alex Barrett in Asia, Noboru Harada in Japan and Ian Town in Australia.
